claims.text: Common bile duct = the common hepatic duct joined by the cystic duct.
claims.quote: the common bile duct (formed by the junction of the common hepatic and cystic ducts)

claims.text: Bile leaves the gallbladder through the cystic duct into the common bile duct.
claims.quote: Bile empties from the gallbladder into the common bile duct via the cystic duct.

claims.text: Ampulla of Vater: the common bile duct joins the pancreatic duct and empties into the duodenum.
claims.quote: The common bile duct joins with the pancreatic duct to form the ampulla of Vater, which empties into the duodenum.

claims.text: The common bile duct tapers to ≤0.6 cm before it joins the pancreatic duct.
claims.quote: Before joining the pancreatic duct, the common bile duct tapers to a diameter of ≤ 0.6 cm.

claims.text: Sphincter of Oddi surrounds both the pancreatic duct and the common bile duct.
claims.quote: The sphincter of Oddi, which surrounds both the pancreatic duct and the common bile duct, includes a sphincter for each duct.

claims.text: Eating makes the gallbladder contract and the sphincter of Oddi relax.
claims.quote: Eating releases gut hormones and stimulates cholinergic nerves, causing the gallbladder to contract and the sphincter of Oddi to relax.
